content: For future work we plan to apply the CAS-LSTM architecture beyond sentence modeling tasks. Various problems e.g. sequence labeling, sequence generation, and language modeling might benefit from sophisticated modulation on context integration. Aggregating diverse contexts from sequential data, e.g. those from forward and backward reading of text, could also be an intriguing research direction.
